title: On Dividing the field into four strips
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：divide　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 divide 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the baker ① divided the field into four strips without complaint, and every customer in the bakery said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the baker ② divides the field into four strips with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ divide the field into four strips at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ divided the field into four strips before — a line in the bill for December 1961 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Dividing the field into four strips without complaint, the baker said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ divide the family for twenty years with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Divide the family for twenty years at once and never mention it again.

By 1974 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the bill, and a new customer from the next bakery ⑧ divides the family for twenty years without complaint every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the oven, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ divided the field into four strips again when nobody else would.

⑩ To divide the field into four strips, my mother said in 1979, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the bakery remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the bakery forgets, somebody divides the field into four strips with great care again and somebody must divide the field into four strips without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 划分（一般过去式 divided the field into four strips：1967 年面点师头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 划分（一般现在 divides the field into four strips：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 划分（不定式 to divide the field into four strips：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 划分（过去完成时 had divided the field into four strips：1961 年十二月的账单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 划分（动名词 dividing the field into four strips 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使分开（divide the family for twenty years：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使分开让一家人分开二十年）
G. v. 使分开（divide the family for twenty years：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 划分（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 divides the family for twenty years，而母亲又一次 divided the field into four strips）

answers.why: divide 意为“划分”，1967 年面点师毫无怨言地划分把地分成四条，那是糕饼铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 divided。
divide 意为“划分”，自那以后面点师小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 divides。
divide 意为“划分”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯划分把地分成四条”，此处为不定式 to divide the field into four strips。
divide 意为“划分”，账单里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1974 年之前就有人划分过，故用过去完成时 had divided。
divide 意为“划分”，面点师说“划分把地分成四条这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 dividing the field into four strips 作主语。
divide 意为“使分开”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使分开让一家人分开二十年”，should ever 之后用原形 divide the family for twenty years。
divide 意为“使分开”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使分开让一家人分开二十年（divide the family for twenty years at once），以后再也不要提起。
divide 意为“划分”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例使分开让一家人分开二十年，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 divides。
divide 意为“划分”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地划分把地分成四条，用一般过去式 divided 叙述。
divide 意为“划分”，结尾那句是母亲 1979 年的话：要划分把地分成四条，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和糕饼铺记住的那一件。

多年以后，面点师仍小心翼翼地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（divides the field into four strips）

面点师说过，毫无怨言地划分把地分成四条这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（dividing the field into four strips 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻使分开让一家人分开二十年，以后再也不要提起。（divide the family for twenty years，祈使句）

Three weeks on, the baker still divides the field into four strips with great care without being asked.
My mother said later that to divide the field into four strips at all was the part nobody had expected.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 divide 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1967 the baker divided the field into four strips without complaint, and nobody in the bakery forgot it.
Even now the baker divides the field into four strips with great care whenever the bakery asks.
Dividing the field into four strips without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever divide the family for twenty years with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next bakery divides the family for twenty years without complaint every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother divided the field into four strips again, and the bakery remembered that half.
